description: This Java source file 'MainActivity.java' defines the main activity of an Android application demonstrating the use of ShareActionProvider with ViewPager. It handles setting up the UI components, managing content items of different types (text and images), and updating the sharing intent when the displayed content changes.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for handling Content presentation, sharing, and user interaction via ViewPager.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the ViewPager, and registers page change listener.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu and initializes the ShareActionProvider.

methods.name: setShareIntent
methods.description: Updates the ShareActionProvider with the current item's share intent.
